Developed by California startup Satyress, Threehalves is a remote-controlled disaster response robot designed to operate where it would be too dangerous for humans. Its four-legged design provides extra stability, while its humanoid upper body can use powerful tools like chainsaws and impact drivers for rescue and emergency operations in hazardous environments. #interestingfacts #facts #fact #technology #robot

Visual artist Jason Cook  creates kinetic sculptures and robotic installations using electronics, programming and mechanical engineering. In The Walking Chair (2025), an ordinary wooden chair is transformed into a moving machine. A system of motors, mechanical parts and electronic components is attached beneath the seat, allowing the chair’s legs to move. By giving a familiar piece of furniture the ability to walk, Cook changes the way we perceive an everyday object. The chair is no longer simply something we sit on  it becomes an object with a movement of its own. #art #artist #weird #chair #avantgarde

Wooden robots are a type of robot that are made from wood rather than metal or plastic. These robots often have a more organic and natural appearance, making them stand out from their more traditional counterparts. #wooden  robots can be used for a variety of purposes, from educational and research purposes to entertainment and art. Some wooden robots are even able to move and perform tasks, using a #combination of #traditional mechanical components and cutting-edge technology. Overall, wooden robots are a #unique and interesting alternative to traditional robots, offering a new perspective on the capabilities and potential of these incredible #machines.
